description: Agent Hiring: submit a payment setup record for the engagement with the contract: the setup with the payee, the holder of the receiving account, the rail (bank transfer, wire, ACH, card, check, PayPal, USDC on Base, other crypto, payroll or other), the currency, the amount, the schedule and each scheduled payment with its amount and due day; the contract with the party it pays, the rail, the currency, the price, the schedule and the days it starts and ends. The signed report gives the setup and the contract, the payee and the account holder against the party the contract pays, the rail, the currency, the amount and the schedule on each side, and the scheduled payments added up against the amount, and counts them, and names a mismatched setup: a payee or account holder other than the party the contract pays, another rail, currency, amount or schedule than the contract states, and scheduled payments that do not add up; then a payment scheduled before the contract starts or after it ends, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No party the contract pays, no payee, no account holder, no rail on either side, no amount, or a milestone schedule with no scheduled payments leaves the setup unverified. It confirms the payee named is the party the contract names; it moves no funds and holds nothing. Beside it, wever_receiver-identity-check reads how a handoff sender checks a receiving agent’s identity, and wever_vendor-identity-check reads a vendor’s identity evidence as its own read, while the payment check reads the setup’s payee, account holder, rail, currency, amount and schedule against the contract. Verdict hire_payment_mismatched, hire_payment_partial, hire_payment_unverified or hire_payment_matched. POST /api/hire-payment-check. Reads the hiring paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no judgment of whether a candidate is good, qualified in substance or worth hiring, no background check, no contact with referees or issuers, no verification with outside sources and no employment-law advice, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Hiring reads supplied hiring paperwork for consistency between documents: a hiring brief, a credential record, a portfolio or past-work record, a reference, a rate quote, an engagement contract, an availability commitment and a payment setup. Beside it, wever_post-job, wever_accept-job and the other tools of the intent job kit are the execution layer that posts, accepts and settles jobs, and wever_workorder-create and the other wever_workorder tools and wever_agent-work-order-exchange are the action layer that creates, funds, delivers and releases work orders, while this family moves nothing and executes nothing and only reads paperwork before anything is committed; wever_agent-escrow-lite holds and releases escrowed funds, and escrow stays there. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-hiring-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-hiring/.
